english: I'm hungry...
I wonder what teachers eat when nobody's watching.
Ask your teacher: what's the weirdest thing you've eaten for breakfast?

ko: 선생님은 아무도 안 볼 때 뭘 먹을까?
선생님께 물어보세요: 아침으로 먹어본 것 중 가장 이상한 건 뭐예요?

english: Do you think animals dream?
I bet dogs dream about running.
Ask your teacher: what do you think you dreamed about last night?

ko: 강아지는 아마 달리는 꿈을 꿀 거야.
선생님께 물어보세요: 어젯밤에 무슨 꿈을 꿨을 것 같아요?

english: I wonder if teachers were ever naughty children.
Hmm... probably.
Ask your teacher: what's the naughtiest thing you did at school?

ko: 선생님께 물어보세요: 학교 다닐 때 가장 말썽 부린 게 뭐예요?

english: If you could turn into any animal for one day...
which one would you pick?
Ask each other!

ko: 하루 동안 어떤 동물로 변할 수 있다면...

english: I wonder if grown-ups still feel like kids sometimes.
Ask your teacher: do you ever feel like a kid again?

ko: 선생님께 물어보세요: 가끔 다시 어린아이처럼 느껴질 때가 있어요?

english: Wait... is a hot dog a sandwich?
I genuinely don't know.
You decide, and tell your teacher why.

ko: 네 생각을 정하고 선생님께 이유를 말해보세요.

english: Some people never leave their hometown.
I find that amazing.
Ask your teacher: what's the farthest place you've ever traveled?

ko: 어떤 사람들은 평생 고향을 떠나지 않아.
선생님께 물어보세요: 가장 멀리 가본 곳은 어디예요?

english: I think clouds would make terrible pillows.
Too bumpy.
What's something small that scares you?
For me... buttons falling off is scary.
Tell each other your small fears.
I'm proud of something I did today.
I won't say what.
Ask your teacher: what are you proud of this week?

ko: 선생님께 물어보세요: 이번 주에 뿌듯했던 일이 뭐예요?

english: If you found a magic door in your room...
would you open it right away, or wait until morning?
Discuss!
I've got a secret.
...maybe later.
Guess what it might be, and tell your teacher your best guess.
Nobody ever remembers Tuesdays.
Isn't that strange?
Ask your teacher: what's the most boring day of the week?

ko: 선생님께 물어보세요: 일주일 중 가장 심심한 요일이 언제예요?

english: I once forgot my own name for a second.
It was embarrassing.
Ask your teacher: what's an embarrassing moment you remember?

ko: 한 번은 내 이름을 잠깐 잊어버렸어.
선생님께 물어보세요: 기억나는 창피했던 순간이 있어요?

english: I wonder what the world would sound like without birds.
Just... quiet.
Pizza or ice cream. Forever. Pick one.
There is no wrong answer.
But you must defend your choice to your teacher.

ko: 피자 아니면 아이스크림. 평생. 하나만 골라.

english: If colours had flavours...
what would blue taste like?
Tell your teacher your answer.
Today I decided to be brave.
I don't know why I'm telling you this.
Ask your teacher: when did you last feel brave?

ko: 선생님께 물어보세요: 최근에 용감했던 순간이 언제예요?

english: I was going to tell you a fact about the moon.
...actually, never mind.
What do YOU know about the moon?

ko: 너는 달에 대해 뭘 알고 있어?

english: I wonder what school will be like in 100 years.
Maybe no homework at all.
Ask your teacher: what do you think school will be like in the future?

ko: 선생님께 물어보세요: 미래의 학교는 어떤 모습일 것 같아요?
